Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Create a refined Japanese yarn-shop mobile homepage photograph, portrait 2:3, 2048x3072 if available. Recompose the attached previous attempt into a genuinely immersive lived-in room, not a studio still life. Highest photographic quality.
REFERENCE ROLES: r1/m1.png is the rejected previous composition, not the quality target. site_wide and room_mobile establish the cream-plaster room, aged honey oak, daylight and depth. The five product photos are strict yarn identity references. Never copy their labels or backgrounds.
COMPOSITION / HARD SAFE ZONES: coordinates are percentages from top left. Top 14% quiet. Rectangle x8–85%, y18–49% is unobstructed cream plaster, with very subtle tonal gradation only: no objects, shelves, curtain, strong shadows or bright patches. ALL foreground yarn and props start at y60% or lower, including every hair. Do not enlarge the yarn group upward. Main cake top y61%, bottom y83%. Place the room's narrow window recess / linen curtain edge only at far right x91–100%, starting below y16%; never intrude into the text rectangle. Reveal depth below y52%: rear wall meets a softly lit side wall near right edge, low oak yarn cubby in the background at x67–100%, y54–72%, a gap of visible floor and shadow separates it from foreground worktable. Back shelf contains a modest irregular assortment of unlabelled ivory and muted blue yarn, not repeated clones. Foreground tabletop recedes diagonally, with its far edge around y69% left and y74% right. A small glimpse of lower table edge, wooden floor and jute rug at lower left gives physical room scale. Main products remain clearly readable in lower 40%.
PRODUCTS: six distinct yarn units, faithful to product references.
1. Large feather-yarn cake at x35%, center y73%, bounds approximately x16–55%, y61–84%. Broad cylindrical cake slightly tilted, spiral end oblique rather than perfectly front-facing; peach-pink center, pale cream intermediate ring and pale icy aqua-blue outer ring, exactly like the central cake in s1_魔法球. Fine long fluffy fibers over visible winding. Not a sphere, no rust gradient.
2. Caramel bouclé center-pull ball at x64%, y81%, bounds x49–78%, y73–88%. Exact warm light caramel of s1_圈圈纱, many small irregular fiber loops tied into continuous thin yarn cores, airy matte surface; not popcorn or knitted stitches. Opening oblique, organically wound.
3. Delicate section-dyed SuperMohair ball behind at x77%, y69%, top no higher than y61%. Rose/salmon pink transitioning through cream to fresh pale yellow-green, matching s1_轻语SuperMohair段染. Fine thin strands and sparse hair, not thick yarn; keep fresh green rather than dull olive.
4. Small pale cool pink kid mohair oval at x16%, y84%, matching pink s1_幼马海毛, fine soft cloudy hair and barely visible thin winding. One physically continuous thin pink yarn tail lies in a relaxed imperfect curve across the foreground table with a visible free end. No floating fibers.

ENVIRONMENT / COLOR: cream plaster #F9F6F0, honey oak with restrained authentic wear and tiny scratches. In rear right alcove BELOW y56%, one small matte terracotta ceramic cup (#AB5631 family), understated and naturally placed. One rumpled washed terracotta linen corner at lower-left table edge with a small butter-yellow selvedge, no decorative pattern. Let these environmental accents echo the brand; never recolor yarns. One small CLOSED brass-handled steel embroidery scissors at x59%, y94%, correct two loops, one pivot, closed blades. Cup and scissors are the only tools/ceramics. No plants or baskets.
LIGHT / OPTICS: real soft lateral daylight from a window to the left outside the frame, with broad layered penumbra, subtle reflected light and gentle light falloff across walls. Restrained sun/curtain shadow only outside safe rectangle, mainly on lower wall, rear floor and wood. Right curtain is softly bounce-lit. Bright but not flat; accurate neutral product color, no yellow filter. Real contact shadows, dimmer recesses of shelf, foreground-midground-background separation, natural 50mm lens f/4 depth of field, hero fibers sharp, rear shelf modestly softer but recognizable. High-end editorial interior photograph, understated and tactile. Wall fine limewash texture rather than coarse stucco everywhere. Do not fake depth with heavy blur.
EXCLUSIONS: no people, animals, text, letters, digits, logo, tags, bands, labels, watermark, UI. No floating motes, glowing fuzz, CGI, plastic, excessive halos, impossible tools, disconnected threads, repeated yarn clones. No objects or strong window shadows in copy-safe rectangle.
